method_overview.implementation_summary: Enable robust 3D understanding for an LLM while reducing dependence on large-scale 3D paired data. The implementation follows Stage I: Text-First Interface Warmup, Stage II: Rich Instruction Alignment, Stage III: Point-Language Transfer, Runtime and saving behavior. Key code modules include TrainingArguments, PointcloudEncoder, PointNet2ClassificationSSG, training_step.
method_overview.architecture_summary: The architecture is centered on TrainingArguments, PointcloudEncoder, PointNet2ClassificationSSG, training_step. End-to-end data flow is organized as Stage I: Text-First Interface Warmup -> Stage II: Rich Instruction Alignment -> Stage III: Point-Language Transfer -> Runtime and saving behavior.
